description_sq:
Apartamenti ndodhet ne nje nga rezidencat me te reja dhe elegante ne ndertim ne Don Bosko.
Organizohet ne:
1 ambient te perbashket ndenje dhe ngrenie
2 dhoma gjumi
2 tualete
2 ballkone
ne nje siperfaqe te brendshme prej 104.5 m2 dhe totale prej 124.4 m2.
Apartamenti orientohet i gjithi nga jugu i cili ben qe te jete i ndricuar mire dhe i ngrohte. Ka nje planimetri shume te rregullt dhe te favorshme per cdo lloj mobilimi.
Aktualisht eshte ne faze ndertimi dhe punimet mbarojne ne Dhjetor 2026.
Per nje vizite ne prone mos hezitoni te na kontaktoni
title_en: APARTMENT FOR SALE 2+1+2 IN DON BOSCO
description_en: The apartment is located in one of the newest and most elegant residences under construction in Don Bosco. It is organized in: 1 common living and dining area, 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, 2 balconies in an internal area of ​​104.5 m2 and a total of 124.4 m2. The apartment is all oriented to the south, which makes it well lit and warm. It has a very regular and favorable layout for any type of furniture. It is currently under construction and the works will be completed in December 2026. For a visit to the property, do not hesitate to contact us
